title: Our Bus Only Comes If You TALK 🚏
description:
At our bus stop, the fare isn't money. Two strangers have to talk. Nobody here talks.

The chalk on the shelter says forty-one days since the last bus.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
